integrity: A complete analytic proof and a self-contained deterministic numerical cross-check are included. Finite-section computations corroborate but do not prove the infinite-dimensional statement. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is the second variation of the top-two spectral sum only along fixed area-preserving smooth radial-squared deformations. It is not a global optimality theorem, is not uniform in perturbation profiles, and has no independent mathematical validation or certified historical priority.
title: Exact rank-two Gaussian localization curvature at a disk
